body: A creative toolkit for generating and editing visual media with image and video models.
plain_description: **Create and refine AI-generated images and videos for your creative work.** Use the canvas to edit and iterate, and build reusable workflows to support production needs.
technical_description: Invoke is a locally hosted web server and React UI for generating and refining visual media with AI models. It includes a unified canvas with inpainting and brush tools, workflow and node management, and a gallery for organizing and remixing content. The README lists support for many image models and some GGUF models; Nano Banana, GPT Image, and Wan are listed as API-only.
title: Invoke
